subject: Auditor portal access: MFA blocked — request for extended window and bridge letter
content:
From: Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Hi Rafael,

We're preparing for Acme's vendor audit and ThirdEye will need access to your trust portal to download the SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence for the audit window Jan 1, 2024 — Dec 31, 2024. Can you provision a temporary auditor account or send a time-limited portal link?

Key asks:
- Portal access for ThirdEye (they use SAML + MFA)
- SOC 2 Type II (covering 2024 audit period) or bridge letter if report is pending
- Evidence download window of at least 5 business days

Auditor contact: portal@thirdeye-audit.com (attn: L. Moreno)

Thanks — please confirm the link and expiry.

Best,
Sam Riley
Security Program Lead
Acme Corp

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads-up.

We can provide a time-limited portal link or create a temporary auditor user. For speed I generated a secure portal URL that will allow the auditor to authenticate and download the report/evidence:  https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/records/ACME-2027-03?token=expiring-72h

Notes / caveats:
- The current link expires in 72 hours from issuance (standard policy).
- Our portal enforces MFA for external auditor accounts; depending on the auditor's SAML provider they may be required to complete a one-time MFA enrollment.
- Attached are brief access instructions for ThirdEye to follow (attachment: access-instructions.pdf).

If the auditor cannot complete MFA or the SAML flow, we can:
1) Extend the link window (requires approval from Compliance) or
2) Provision a short-lived local auditor account (email tied to portal) and revoke after download.

If you want a bridge letter confirming the audit period and current status, loop in our compliance lead (cc'd).

Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0186

Attachment: access-instructions.pdf (PDF, 74KB)

---

From: ThirdEye Audit <portal@thirdeye-audit.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Hi Rafael,

We received the link but ran into an enrollment error in the MFA step tied to our SAML provider (Okta). The portal prompts for a WebAuthn/Passkey enrollment which their org blocks for external auditors. We couldn't complete enrollment and were kicked back to the SSO screen.

Could Acme or Redwood either: 1) extend the link window while we troubleshoot with our Okta admin, or 2) provide a temporary auditor credential (username + password + one-time OTP) that bypasses the SAML redirect so we can finish downloads?

Also, the audit firm requests a bridge letter if the Type II report is not yet uploaded showing the period covered and expected availability date.

LM
Operations Manager
ThirdEye Audit
portal@thirdeye-audit.com

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>, ThirdEye Audit <portal@thirdeye-audit.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Neha / Vivek — can you advise on the fastest safe approach here? Auditor couldn't complete MFA via SAML (Okta -> passkey blocked). Options I see: extend the trust portal token (we typically do +72h), or provision a short-lived local auditor account (email: portal@thirdeye-audit.com) and then revoke. Acme also asked for a bridge letter covering JanDec 2024 if the Type II isn't uploaded yet.

Their timeline: need evidence download window of ~5 business days. If we extend the link, can we do +7 days (compliance sign-off)? If we create a local account, what protections/logging should we attach to the ticket? Please advise and, if possible, prepare a bridge letter draft.

Thanks,
Rafael

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>, ThirdEye Audit <portal@thirdeye-audit.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Hi all,

We can proceed as follows (balancing auditor needs with security controls):

1) Link extension: I can approve a 7-calendar-day extension to the existing portal token. This is the fastest path and keeps SSO/MFA behavior intact.
2) Local temp account: only if the auditor confirms they cannot complete SAML/MFA. If we provision a local account we will:
   - Create a single-use local login tied to portal@thirdeye-audit.com
   - Require a one-time OTP we generate and transmit via a separate channel (phone)
   - Enable strict session timeout (30 minutes of inactivity) and download-only role (no admin access)
   - Audit trail: full activity logging and notify Acme security and Redwood compliance on first login
3) Bridge letter: I've attached a draft bridge-letter-draft.docx. It states our current SOC 2 Type II coverage through 12/31/2024 and indicates the expected availability of the formal report (if applicable). Please review and confirm wording.

To proceed I need:
- Auditor confirmation: will they retry SAML flow if we extend? If not, confirm they want a local account.
- Full auditor name and contact phone for OTP delivery.

Rafael: please confirm you want the 7-day extension now so ThirdEye can retry before we create a local account.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 510 555 0102

Attachment: bridge-letter-draft.docx (DOCX, 36KB)

---

From: ThirdEye Audit <portal@thirdeye-audit.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: auditor portal invite + SOC 2 Type II (2024)

Hi Neha / Rafael,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll attempt the SAML flow again if you can extend the token 7 days — please confirm once the link is extended. If the retry fails, please provision the local account.

Auditor contact for OTP:
Laura Moreno — +1 312 555 0147
portal@thirdeye-audit.com

Also, we confirm the audit window to be covered in the bridge letter: Jan 1, 2024 1 Dec 31, 2024. Once the bridge letter is provided we'll include it in the evidence bundle.

LM
ThirdEye Audit
